description:
Who doesn't love Strawberries and Cream? NOBODY!!
Thats why you should make this delicious strawberries and cream gelato, it's super easy, tastes incredible and can be done in a traditional ice cream machine or ninja creami. 

------------------

Like fruit ice creams? Try this Blueberry ice cream: 
https://youtu.be/z1T75sEi0Ys?si=sa2hndrAa33qY1vk

-----------------

How about a Haagen Dazs Straberry Cheesecake? 
https://youtu.be/gtnwc1K06o8?si=jKtP0LiwTvmXRzDr

-----------------

Join this channel:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjYtWtUzbtxFLufK6bCJrxQ/join
Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/icecreamery
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/PolarIceCreamery

comments.text: Is there a way to make Strawberry Ice Cream / Gelato without cooking them? Thanks! :)

comments.text: The cooking of fruit is increase the flavor exponentially and to reduce the water content. It would be possible to make it without cooking the fruit but the flavor won’t be super strong and the color would be different. Then you have to balance against the new higher amounts of water. Also cooking the fruit changes the sugars to something more like inverted sugar which helps the recipe. If you account for these, yes it possible.
